title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION relative to the First Amendment to the agreement with AECOM Technical Services,…
text:
[Council File 26-1561; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION relative to the First Amendment to the agreement with AECOM Technical Services, Inc., for engineering and architectural services for the Port of Los Angeles Goods Movement Workforce Training Facility.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the determination by the Board of Harbor Commissioners that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Port of Los Angeles Resolution No. 26-10806 authorizing the First Amendment to Agreement No. 26-9996-A with AECOM Technical Services, Inc., extending the agreement by five additional years through December 19, 2031, for a total term of eight years, and increasing compensation by $4,363,157, for a total not-to-exceed amount of $14,140,298, for engineering and architectural services for the Port of Los Angeles Goods Movement Workforce Training Facility.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Harbor Commissioners reports that approval of the First Amendment will increase the agreement's maximum compensation by $4,363,157, for a total of $14,140,298. Funding is available in Account 161305 (Construction in Progress), Division 00000 (Global Harbor), Project 2568400 (Goods Movement Workforce Training Facility). Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 26, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026
summary: Council would extend the AECOM design contract for the Port's Goods Movement Workforce Training Facility by five years, to 2031, and add $4,363,157 for a total of $14,140,298.
